participation.context: Counted the turns of the glass and said he had come to hear Lent named.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Preached Septuagesima, promised brevity, and turned the sand-glass a second time.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

participation.context: Timed the second turn of the glass, and noted that he had not said starch.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Sat three rows ahead in the Mayor's pew and did not speak.
participation.name: Sir John Spencer

relations.note: she times his glass by the second turn

story.body: You stood the sermon with Mistress Ansell. Master Thwaite reached fourteenthly and turned the glass twice. Sir John Spencer did not turn his head. You took the naming of Lent and left the rest in the church.

relations.note: she times his glass by the second turn

title: Heard Master Thwaite name Lent and turn the glass a second time

participation.context: Accepted the penny, the sixpence and the threepence, and did not reopen the January verdict.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Measured the loaf, entered the sixpence, and reminded him of the ruling she had already given.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Set the loaf to the notch, left Gib where he was, and put one candle by the desk.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Took the same threepence and said he does not know plays.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

participation.context: Lay on the book and was left there.
participation.name: Gib

relations.note: she keeps his firing at sixpence and his board at threepence
relations.quote: Your sixpence for firing and washing is entered.

story.body: You sat the meal and were put down for threepence. The loaf was a penny and a finger short. The sixpence was entered. You did not ask Mistress Ansell to rule the comedy again. You told her the ladies have the better of it, and you left the letter until after three.

relations.note: she keeps his firing at sixpence and his board at threepence
relations.quote: Your sixpence for firing and washing is entered.

title: Ate a penny loaf a finger short
